| [ADOPT-02](adoption/conventions-declaration.md#adopt-02) | The conventions declaration is valid against its schema | EC-0001 | proposed | warning | jsonschema |

| [ADOPT-05](adoption/conventions-declaration.md#adopt-05) | A waiver expires within 180 days | EC-0001 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [ADOPT-06](adoption/conventions-declaration.md#adopt-06) | A waiver that suppresses nothing is removed | EC-0001 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [ADOPT-07](adoption/conventions-declaration.md#adopt-07) | The declaration names a profile the release defines | EC-0001 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [ADOPT-08](adoption/conventions-declaration.md#adopt-08) | The declared version is the version of the bundle being run | EC-0001 | proposed | warning | conftest |

| [GHA-02](github-actions/workflow-files.md#gha-02) | An entry-point workflow starts with a responsibility token | EC-0002 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-03](github-actions/workflow-files.md#gha-03) | The reusable- prefix marks exactly the workflows triggered only by workflow_call | EC-0002 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-04](github-actions/workflow-files.md#gha-04) | A reusable workflow names a responsibility or capability token | EC-0002 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-05](github-actions/workflow-files.md#gha-05) | A workflow filename carries no trigger, schedule, tool or synonym token | EC-0002 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-06](github-actions/workflow-files.md#gha-06) | A repository uses one workflow file extension | EC-0002 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-07](github-actions/workflow-files.md#gha-07) | A workflow's name is its filename stem in Title Case | EC-0002 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-08](github-actions/workflow-files.md#gha-08) | Workflow names are unique within a repository | EC-0002 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-09](github-actions/workflow-files.md#gha-09) | A workflow_run trigger names a workflow that exists | EC-0002 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-10](github-actions/jobs-and-steps.md#gha-10) | Job IDs and step IDs are snake_case | EC-0003 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-11](github-actions/jobs-and-steps.md#gha-11) | Every job declares a name, unique within its workflow | EC-0003 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-12](github-actions/jobs-and-steps.md#gha-12) | An entry-point job is named \<Subject\>[ / \<Check\>]; only a required-check job leads with its workflow's name | EC-0003 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-13](github-actions/jobs-and-steps.md#gha-13) | A job in a callable workflow has a bare name | EC-0003 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-14](github-actions/jobs-and-steps.md#gha-14) | An aggregate job runs even when a dependency fails, and needs every other job | EC-0003 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-15](github-actions/jobs-and-steps.md#gha-15) | Every required status check is a context exactly one job emits | EC-0003 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-16](github-actions/jobs-and-steps.md#gha-16) | A multi-job workflow is required only through its aggregate | EC-0003 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-17](github-actions/jobs-and-steps.md#gha-17) | Every run step has a name | EC-0003 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-18](github-actions/jobs-and-steps.md#gha-18) | A step name is an imperative verb phrase | EC-0003 | proposed | warning | review |
| [GHA-19](github-actions/jobs-and-steps.md#gha-19) | A tool is named only when the tool is the subject | EC-0003 | proposed | warning | review |
| [GHA-20](github-actions/composite-actions.md#gha-20) | An action directory is \<action-token\>-\<object\> | EC-0004 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-21](github-actions/composite-actions.md#gha-21) | An action's metadata is action.yml, one level below .github/actions | EC-0004 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-22](github-actions/composite-actions.md#gha-22) | An action's name is its directory in Title Case | EC-0004 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-23](github-actions/composite-actions.md#gha-23) | An action and each of its inputs have a description | EC-0004 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-24](github-actions/execution-hygiene.md#gha-24) | A third-party action is pinned to a full commit SHA | EC-0005 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-25](github-actions/execution-hygiene.md#gha-25) | A SHA pin carries the version it resolves to as a comment | EC-0005 | proposed | warning | review |
| [GHA-26](github-actions/execution-hygiene.md#gha-26) | A workflow declares permissions at the workflow level | EC-0005 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-27](github-actions/execution-hygiene.md#gha-27) | Workflow-level permissions grant no write access; jobs widen them | EC-0005 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-28](github-actions/execution-hygiene.md#gha-28) | actions/checkout does not persist credentials | EC-0005 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-29](github-actions/execution-hygiene.md#gha-29) | Every job that runs steps sets timeout-minutes | EC-0005 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-30](github-actions/execution-hygiene.md#gha-30) | An entry point on pull_request or merge_group uses the standard concurrency group | EC-0005 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-31](github-actions/execution-hygiene.md#gha-31) | A workflow triggered only by workflow_call declares no concurrency | EC-0005 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-32](github-actions/execution-hygiene.md#gha-32) | A workflow that emits a required check has no paths filter | EC-0005 | proposed | warning | conftest |
| [GHA-33](github-actions/execution-hygiene.md#gha-33) | Workflows pass actionlint and zizmor at medium severity | EC-0005 | proposed | warning | delegated |
| [GHA-34](github-actions/units-and-renames.md#gha-34) | A new workflow, job, action or reusable workflow is chosen by the unit criteria | EC-0006 | proposed | warning | review |
| [GHA-35](github-actions/units-and-renames.md#gha-35) | Validation is split into validate workflows by what they judge | EC-0006 | proposed | warning | review |
| [GHA-36](github-actions/units-and-renames.md#gha-36) | A rename updates every reference to the renamed identity in the same change | EC-0006 | proposed | warning | review |
| [GHA-37](github-actions/units-and-renames.md#gha-37) | A name states the responsibility, result or capability, not the trigger or tool | EC-0006 | proposed | warning | review |
| [GHA-38](github-actions/composite-actions.md#gha-38) | Inputs and outputs of actions and reusable workflows are kebab-case | EC-0004 | proposed | warning | conftest |
